segments.text: Zebra crossing ahead. Nobody waiting. Easy.
But one of the stripes just blinked. A real zebra is lying on it. What do you do?
Most drivers honk, to make her move.
Big mistake. She jumps up and runs off. And the stripes go with her.
No stripes, no crossing. So everyone just walks over your car instead. A school class. A brass band. An elephant.
Here's how you do it properly.
Stop at the line, and wait. A zebra crossing belongs to the zebra.
She stands up, stretches, and trots across.
And every stripe she steps on plays a note. It's a piano!
She's so happy, she gives you a thank-you present. Stripes!
Your car is a zebra now. Best camouflage in town.
Next exam question: the tow truck is a giant crab. Follow, so you don't miss it.
